clauses.condition_explanation: The separate terms must be consulted; their permissions and restrictions are not supplied here.

clauses.scope_note: This License applies only to Licensed Material versions distributed with it and does not revoke or alter permissions previously granted under a separate license or agreement.
clauses.condition_explanation: The clause defines the scope of this License and preserves prior permissions; it does not specify the terms of other versions or agreements.

clauses.scope_note: Licensed Material; section 2 evaluation license, subject to the stated purpose and section 2's productive-work restriction.
clauses.condition_explanation: The purpose must be one of the listed evaluation purposes and must not be ordinary productive work; the latter restriction is stated in section 2.

clauses.scope_note: Licensed Material; inspection is permitted solely for section 2's enumerated purposes, subject to its productive-work restriction.
clauses.condition_explanation: Inspection is distinct from copying, loading, modifying, or running; the listed purpose and non-productive-work condition both apply.

clauses.scope_note: Loading Licensed Material is permitted solely for section 2's enumerated purposes, subject to its productive-work restriction.
clauses.condition_explanation: Loading is expressly listed as an evaluation action; it must satisfy the listed purpose and non-productive-work condition.

clauses.scope_note: Modifying Licensed Material is permitted solely for section 2's enumerated purposes, subject to its productive-work restriction.
clauses.condition_explanation: The modification must be for a listed evaluation purpose and not ordinary productive work.

clauses.scope_note: Running Licensed Material is permitted solely for section 2's enumerated purposes, subject to its productive-work restriction.
clauses.condition_explanation: Running is expressly listed as an evaluation action; it must satisfy the listed purpose and non-productive-work condition.

clauses.scope_note: The evaluation permission does not allow using evaluation to perform ordinary productive work for oneself or another person or organization.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies when the action is evaluation and its use performs the specified productive work.

obligation_items.content: Do not use evaluation to perform ordinary productive work.
obligation_items.trigger: When using Licensed Material under the evaluation permission to perform ordinary productive work for oneself or another person or organization.

clauses.scope_note: Defines Operational Use: using, loading, adapting, embedding, invoking, or materially incorporating Licensed Material in a listed system for the stated purpose. The definition does not itself grant permission.
clauses.condition_explanation: The listed action, system context, and purpose beyond Evaluation identify Operational Use; this definition is context for the restrictions in lines 25 and 27.

clauses.scope_note: This public License grants no Operational Use license; section 27 requires a separate paid license to make Operational Use.
clauses.condition_explanation: Operational Use is as defined in section 3; a separate paid Operational License is required under section 27. This public License itself supplies no such grant.

obligation_items.content: Do not make Operational Use under this public License without a separate paid Operational License.
obligation_items.trigger: When making Operational Use and no separate paid Operational License has been obtained.

clauses.scope_note: Operational Use requires obtaining a separate paid license from the Licensor; commercial terms may vary by agreed metric. The clause does not state specific fees or terms.
clauses.condition_explanation: Operational Use is as defined in section 3. The licensee must obtain a separate paid license before making that use; the payment is not modeled as Charge, which concerns charging third parties.

obligation_items.content: Do not make Operational Use until a separate paid license has been obtained from the Licensor.
obligation_items.trigger: Before making Operational Use, unless a stated exception applies.

clauses.scope_note: Lists possible evidence of an Operational License; it does not require a particular evidence form or independently grant permission.
clauses.condition_explanation: Evidence may take any listed form or another record that reasonably identifies the licensee and licensed scope.

clauses.scope_note: The named compliance materials may be used without charge solely for the purposes listed in lines 35–39, subject to the restriction in line 41.
clauses.condition_explanation: The purpose must be understanding the terms, auditing own use, determining whether a license is required, preparing or sending an inquiry to the Licensor, or responding to a compliance inquiry concerning this repository.

clauses.scope_note: The named compliance materials may be copied without charge solely for the purposes listed in lines 35–39, subject to the restriction in line 41.
clauses.condition_explanation: The purpose must be one of the listed repository-licensing compliance purposes; general-purpose enforcement for unrelated works is excluded.

clauses.scope_note: Limits the section 4 exception; it does not permit using the compliance skill as a general-purpose enforcement product or service for unrelated works.
clauses.condition_explanation: Applies to use of the compliance skill under the exception when the purpose is general-purpose enforcement for unrelated works.

obligation_items.content: Do not use the compliance skill as a general-purpose enforcement product or service for unrelated works.
obligation_items.object: repository license-enforcement skill, its references, and machine-readable licensing policy
obligation_items.trigger: When relying on the section 4 exception to use those materials for unrelated works.

clauses.scope_note: Redistribution of unmodified copies of Licensed Material is allowed only for the listed purposes and with the License and applicable notices preserved.
clauses.condition_explanation: The purpose alternatives are evaluation, archival, review, or discussion. The copy must be unmodified, and both the License and all applicable notices must be preserved.

obligation_items.content: Preserve this License and all applicable notices in the redistributed copy.
obligation_items.trigger: When redistributing the copy for evaluation, archival, review, or discussion.

clauses.scope_note: Redistribution under section 5 does not grant the recipient Operational Use rights; Operational Use requires a separate paid license under section 3.
clauses.condition_explanation: The recipient's permitted receipt of a copy does not itself authorize Operational Use; the separate-license requirement remains applicable.

obligation_items.content: Do not make Operational Use of the redistributed Licensed Material without a separate paid Operational License.
obligation_items.trigger: When the recipient makes Operational Use and has not obtained a separate paid Operational License.

clauses.scope_note: A paid Operational License may grant broader redistribution rights in writing; this clause does not itself grant those rights.
clauses.condition_explanation: Broader redistribution is permitted only to the extent a separate paid Operational License grants it in writing.
